01employ/ɪmˈplɔɪ/ ✓ 已标记
v. 雇用
The company plans to employ ten new workers this year.
搭配：employ sb as sth；名词是 employment。
02employee/ɪmˈplɔɪiː/ ✓ 已标记
n. 雇员；员工
Every employee gets a free lunch on Friday.
区分：employee 是员工，employer 是雇主。
03employer/ɪmˈplɔɪər/ ✓ 已标记
n. 雇主
My employer allows us to work from home twice a week.
搭配：a good employer（好雇主）。
04profession/prəˈfeʃn/ ✓ 已标记
n. 职业
Teaching is a profession that needs patience.
搭配：choose a profession；by profession（就职业而言）。
05career/kəˈrɪər/ ✓ 已标记
n. 职业；生涯
She wants a career in medicine.
搭配：a career in + 领域；career 作“生涯”时常指一生的职业发展。
06interview/ˈɪntərvjuː/ ✓ 已标记
n. 面试；采访
I have a job interview tomorrow morning.
搭配：have an interview；interview 作动词也是“采访”。
07salary/ˈsæləri/ ✓ 已标记
n. 薪水
Her monthly salary is higher than mine.
区分：salary 是月薪 / 年薪，wage 常指按小时或按周算的工资。
08income/ˈɪnkʌm/ ✓ 已标记
n. 收入
His income comes mainly from his shop.
搭配：a high / low income；income tax 是所得税。
09resign/rɪˈzaɪn/ ✓ 已标记
v. 辞职

搭配：resign from sth；resign 后面常跟 from。
10retire/rɪˈtaɪər/ ✓ 已标记
v. 退休
My grandfather will retire at the age of sixty.
搭配：retire from work；名词是 retirement。
11promote/prəˈmoʊt/ ✓ 已标记
v. 提升；促进

搭配：promote sb to + 职位；promote 也可作“促进”。
12promotion/prəˈmoʊʃn/ ✓ 已标记
n. 晋升；促销

13responsible/rɪˈspɑːnsəbl/ ✓ 已标记

14duty/ˈduːti/ ✓ 已标记

15skill/skɪl/ ✓ 已标记
n. 技能

16experience/ɪkˈspɪəriəns/ ✓ 已标记

17require/rɪˈkwaɪər/ ✓ 已标记

18quality/ˈkwɑːləti/ ✓ 已标记

19efficient/ɪˈfɪʃnt/ ✓ 已标记

21manager/ˈmænɪdʒər/ ✓ 已标记

22meeting/ˈmiːtɪŋ/ ✓ 已标记

23report/rɪˈpɔːrt/ ✓ 已标记
